question: What does the llm/stream repair wrapper cost per chunk, against iterating the same stream without it?
method: createRemedy() from the built plugin, mounted on a minimal context; the control consumes the same async generator without the listener; median of the runs listed per scenario

repair.reason: the third scenario is a proven fusion, so a wrapper that never ran would show zero here

limits: one machine and one node build; absolute milliseconds move with the host, the ratio is the claim
synthetic chunks: real turns spend most of their time waiting on the provider, so this measures the tax, not the turn
the wrapper is synchronous by contract; a thenable stream re-enters through .then and is not exercised here
